description:
Imogen Baker’s fourth release as Enofa after retiring her previously prolific and successful project International Debris.

‘All Roads Lead To Polesworth’ marks Third Kind’s first release from Imogen Baker since 2017’s ‘Seltrac’. Both albums convey a gently psychedelic futurism, but where ‘Seltrac’ seemed to nod to the spacey and robotic moments of 70’s kosmische, Tangerine Dream and Kraftwerk, ‘All Roads’ appears to contain a multitude of half memories from 90’s ecstasy clubland; like a lost and found mixtape playing in a lucid dream.

“...a sense that this hi-NRG electronic pulsefest is a total throwback to 90s raver culture, the energetic rhythms and effortless melodies perfect for that retrofuturist dancefloor. I’ve gotta say, too, that I’m a sucker for what Baker’s slinging here – I can pop this on and relax to it all day, proving that you don’t need to stand up and wiggle to thoroughly enjoy it. And trust me – I’m an expert at sitting down these days.... It’s not easy to put together such a streamlined body of work as All Roads, but Baker weaves in and out of cuts like they're assembling an expert mixtape, the more fervent tunes residing with equal comfort and natural placement next to chillaxed comedowns.” Ryan Masteller - Cassette Gods.
